integrity: The stationary current is derived from an explicit linear covariance equation; the unique central-mass optimum is proved by a global nonnegative-square identity. Direct exact symbolic checks and eight full rational covariance reconstructions were run; finite checks do not independently prove arbitrary-parameter algebra.
scientific_limitations: Three-site classical chain, unit endpoint masses and springs, uniform positive onsite pinning, equal endpoint white-noise Langevin frictions, and only the stationary mean heat conductance. Positive bath temperatures. An equivalent prior special-case optimization may be unlocated; independent validation has not occurred.
title: A bath-independent optimal central mass in a pinned three-oscillator Langevin chain
